title: Builder: a presentation default for every role on all ten site themes
detail: components/sites/presentation/*.ts sets 0 to 9 role defaults per theme today (Default 0, Free Human 5, Bold and Wildheart 6, Designer 7, Network 7, Temple 8, Nocturne 9). Give each theme a default variant for all 23 roles, chosen from that theme's design system, one file per theme, no new art. A layout an owner picked still wins. Done when: presentationDefault(theme, role) is defined for every theme and role pair and presentation.test.ts pins the table.

verify.evidence: Filed from the builder v3 audit. The pass writes scripts/probes/builder/BLD-212.mjs, proves it fails before the change and passes after, and switches this row to kind cmd in the same PR.
